game.title.description: Name of the 2048 game card on the home screen.
game.title.notes: Do not translate the game name.

game.description.description: Short description of the 2048 game on the home screen.

game.playLabel.description: Accessibility label for the play button on the 2048 game card.

score.accessibilityLabel.description: Screen reader label for the current score.

score.best.description: Label above the best-score value on the in-game scoreboard, next to the current score.

score.bestAccessibilityLabel.description: Accessibility label for the best-score value on the in-game scoreboard.

actions.newGame.description: Button text to start a new game.

actions.newGameLabel.description: Accessibility label for the new game button.

actions.keepPlaying.description: Button text to continue playing after reaching 2048.

actions.keepPlayingLabel.description: Accessibility label for the keep playing button.

swipe.hint.description: Hint text shown below the score to guide the player.

controls.keyboardHint.description: Hint text under the swipe hint, shown only on web, telling the player they can also use the arrow keys.

win.body.description: Message shown when the player wins, encouraging them to continue.

stats.highestTile.description: Label for the highest tile value reached, shown on the 2048 stats bento.

stats.timePlayed.description: Label for total time played, shown on the 2048 stats bento.

scoreboard.heroLabel.description: Label above the hero value (current/best score) on the 2048 scoreboard.
scoreboard.heroLabel.notes: All caps in English, matching other games' scoreboard hero labels.

scoreboard.heroSub.description: Caption under the scoreboard's hero value, showing the best tile and move count of the most recent game.

scoreboard.heroSubEmpty.description: Caption under the scoreboard's hero value when no game has been played yet.

scoreboard.bestScore.description: Label on the stat tile for the player's all-time best score.

scoreboard.bestTile.description: Label on the stat tile for the highest tile ever reached.

scoreboard.gamesPlayed.description: Label on the stat tile for the total number of games played.

scoreboard.gamesWon.description: Label on the stat tile for the total number of games won.
